title: Raise hosted manual working memory to 2 GiB
question: How far can hosted manual memory increase without changing the WASI bridge or addressing architecture?
summary: Allow manual 2048 MiB with a 1 GiB tracked ledger and 2 GiB linear ceiling; preserve 256 MiB defaults. The primary larger-budget shuffle avoids external runs/merge and reduces median complete-job elapsed by 19.3%.

120003-row/64-byte unchanged256MiB control; separate unreplicated budget screen and Fisher–Yates capacity/cleanup control.
